# GridPaw

GridPaw is a free online platform for cat-themed logic puzzle games. Three games in one hub:

## Shikaku (Rectangle Partition)
Play at https://gridpaw.com
Drag to draw rectangles on a numbered grid. Each rectangle must cover exactly the number of cells shown. Classic Nikoli puzzle with cute cat visuals.

## Akari (Light Up)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/akari/
Place glowing cats to light up every cell. Numbered walls tell you how many adjacent cats are needed. Pure logic, no guessing.

## Kakuro (Cross Sums)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/kakuro/
Fill runs so they sum to their clues with no repeated digits. Features a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign, exclusive paw-print fog mode and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Nonogram (Picture Logic)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/nonogram/
Paint-by-number logic puzzles: clue numbers give the run lengths of filled cells in each row and column, and a hidden picture emerges when every line is true. Every level reveals a picture (cats throughout), boards are verified single-solution, Easy/Medium are pure line-logic solvable, with a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Nurikabe (Islands and Sea)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/nurikabe/
Grow numbered islands out of a connected sea: each clue is the exact size of its island, every island holds exactly one clue, the sea must stay connected and may never contain a 2×2 square. Every board is solver-verified single-solution, with a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign from 5×5 to 9×9 and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Pictomino (Spatial Reasoning)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/pictomino/
A spatial reasoning puzzle game for kids. Drag and rotate puzzle pieces to fill the grid. Multiple difficulty levels from 3x3 to 5x5.

## Guide Pages
### Arrows Puzzle Walkthrough
Read at https://gridpaw.com/arrows-puzzle-walkthrough/
A complete walkthrough for Arrows – Puzzle Escape (Ecffri): general strategy for early, mid, and late levels, five common stuck points with fixes, level progression tips, and an FAQ. Unofficial fan-made guide.

### Arrows Puzzle (Hub)
Read at https://gridpaw.com/arrows-puzzle/
The hub for the arrows puzzle: what it is, the complete rule set broken down step by step, five beginner tips, where to play, and an FAQ. Links to the full walkthrough.

### Block Blast Hints
Read at https://gridpaw.com/block-blast-hints/
10+ Block Blast hints in three skill tiers (beginner/intermediate/advanced), the five most common mistakes, a high-score strategy loop, and an FAQ. Unofficial fan-made guide.

### Meowdoku Guide
Read at https://gridpaw.com/meowdoku-guide/
A deeper Meowdoku (Oakever) strategy guide: rules recap, six no-hint solving techniques, how to derive answers yourself, a comparison of games like Meowdoku, and an FAQ. Unofficial fan-made guide.

### Cross Math Puzzle
Read at https://gridpaw.com/cross-math-puzzle/
The complete cross math puzzle guide: rules with operator symbols explained, six solving strategies, cross math vs Kakuro comparison table, printable number-combination tips, and an FAQ.

## Features
- Free to play, no registration required
- Works on desktop, tablet, and phone
- Daily challenges with streak tracking
- Multiple difficulty levels
- Cat-themed visuals throughout
